resultJson.title: Add Option/Either conversion sample
resultJson.body:
Adds `eitherheroption/EitherOption.scala`, a runnable sample showing how to convert between `Option` and `Either` in both directions.

- Option to Either: `toRight` and `toLeft`.
- Either to Option: `toOption` and `left.toOption`.
- A round trip showing that `Left` information is lost, plus `Either.cond` and `Option.when` for building each from a boolean.

The diff also includes a `.orca/runs/*.progress.json` progress file, which is not part of the sample.
